title: Hardy inequality and the construction of infinitesimal operators with non-basis family of eigenvectors

read_scope: Targeted read of v4 §2.1, Proposition 3 and §3.1 Theorem 6, with v2 §2.1, Proposition 6 and Theorems 8 and 11 read for the exact logarithmic family. Compared v1 Theorem 3.1 and v3 Proposition 6(4) as version witnesses. The full paper and journal proof were not audited.
correction_history: v1 Theorem 3.1 prints the additional c_0 condition for the logarithmically multiplied sequence. v2 Theorem 8 replaces it by the maximal difference domain. The observation concerns superseded preprints and is not a finding about the journal version.

title: Resolvent of the generator of the C₀-group with non-basis family of eigenvectors and sharpness of the XYZ theorem
publication_status: Published journal article; publisher PDF accessed.
read_scope: Targeted Theorems 1.2, 2.1, and 3.1, including formula (10) and the k=1 resolvent proof. The coefficient resolvent and spectrum apply to the identified logarithmic family.
